title: Final Potential Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electrostatic potential outside the shell must be correctly stated as Phi_+ = (sigma_0 R^3)/(3 epsilon_0 r^2) cos(theta) for r > R.

title: Final Potential Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electrostatic potential inside the shell must be correctly stated as Phi_- = (sigma_0 r)/(3 epsilon_0) cos(theta) for r < R.

title: Final Electric Field Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field outside the shell must be correctly stated as E_+ = (2 sigma_0 R^3)/(3 epsilon_0 r^3) cos(theta) e_r + (sigma_0 R^3)/(3 epsilon_0 r^3) sin(theta) e_theta for r > R.

title: Final Electric Field Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field inside the shell must be correctly stated as E_- = -(sigma_0)/(3 epsilon_0) e_z for r < R.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the boundary conditions at r = R for the potentials and displacement vector.

title: Laplace's Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of Laplace's equation and its application to the problem.

title: Coefficient Matching
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly match coefficients of P_n(cos(theta)) to find the constants a_n and b_n.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign errors in the expressions for electric fields or potentials.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
